newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks down, but off lows, in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks down, but off lows, in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were slightly lower, but off from early lows, in late trade on Wednesday as electronics, electricals and paper shares attracted bargain hunters, brokers said.
The index opened higher on Wall Street's overnight rally, but then fell as recent profit-taking continued.
With 45 minutes left, the index was down 20.11 points or 0.23 percent at 8,572.33, off a 8,528.57 low.
Turnover was a brisk T$78 billion.
Electronics rose 0.59 percent as integrated circuits-related shares surged on hopes they may receive big orders from U.S. chipmaker Intel Corp, with Taiwan Semiconductor up T$3.5 to T$97.
"As electronics turn stronger again, the index may turn to consolidate for a while intead of the originally expected downward corrections," said HSBC James Capel analyst Alex Chen.
